Our Story

Born from a Belief That Love Deserves Intention

Pure Intent was founded by three women who understood, first-hand, how difficult it is to find genuine connection in a world of endless scrolling and surface-level interactions. As professionals who had navigated the highs and heartbreaks of modern dating, they saw a gap — not for another app, but for something more human.

What began as heartfelt conversations between friends grew into a shared mission: to create a space where serious, marriage-minded individuals could be truly seen, carefully matched, and respectfully guided — by people who genuinely care about their outcome.

Today, Pure Intent is built on trust, discretion, and the belief that every person deserves a love story that begins with pure intention. Our team brings together expertise in human behaviour, relationship psychology, and a deep commitment to each member's journey — not just their match.

Our Approach

Matchmaking That Puts You First

We believe meaningful relationships start with being truly seen. Every decision we make is in service of your wellbeing and your future.

  • 🛡️

    Verified Members Only

    Every member is personally screened and verified. You'll only be introduced to individuals who share your commitment to a genuine relationship.

  • 🧠

    Human Intelligence, Not Algorithms

    Our experienced matchmakers make every introduction. They consider character, values, and life vision — not just data points.

  • 🔒

    Absolute Confidentiality

    Your profile, information, and journey with us is completely private. We never share your details without your explicit consent.

Privacy & Trust

Your Story Stays Yours

We are built on the belief that your personal life deserves the highest level of discretion. Privacy is not a feature — it is our foundation.

✓

No Public Profiles

Your information is never visible publicly. Only your matched introduction has access to your profile — and only when you both consent.

✓

Secure Data Handling

All personal data is encrypted, stored securely, and never sold or shared with third parties under any circumstances.

✓

Consent at Every Step

Nothing happens without your knowledge and approval. You are in control of your journey from beginning to end.

✓

Right to Withdraw

You may pause or exit the process at any time. Your data is deleted on request, no questions asked.

Questions

Honest Answers to What You're Wondering

If you don't see your question here, reach out — we're happy to talk through everything with you personally.



Contact Us
How is PURE INTENT different from a dating app? ▾
Unlike apps that rely on algorithms and unlimited swiping, PURE INTENT uses real human matchmakers who take time to understand who you are and what you need. Every introduction is personally curated — quality always over quantity.
Who is eligible to join? ▾
We welcome sincere adults aged 25 and above who are genuinely seeking a long-term, committed relationship. All applicants go through a screening process to ensure the safety and quality of our community.
How long does the process usually take? ▾
Every journey is different. Many members find a compatible connection within their first few months. We focus on finding the right person for you, not the fastest one.
Is my information kept confidential? ▾
Absolutely. Privacy is central to everything we do. Your profile is never publicly visible, and your information is never shared without your explicit consent. Everything discussed with your matchmaker stays strictly confidential.
Can I pause or cancel my membership? ▾
Yes. You are always in control. You can pause your membership at any time — for example, if you're getting to know someone — and resume when you're ready. Cancellation is straightforward with no hidden penalties.
Do you offer a free consultation? ▾
Yes. Before committing to any plan, we invite you for a complimentary introductory call with one of our matchmakers. It's a no-pressure conversation so we can understand your goals and you can understand our approach.
